intents: Establish a deployable, secure technical foundation (Next.js on Cloudflare Workers + Supabase) with coding/responsive conventions documented for future feature work
justification: Sub-areas (deploy tooling, Supabase clients, security headers, responsive conventions, smoke test) are components of one infrastructure intent, not independent user-facing features with their own screens/APIs — kept SINGLE rather than decomposed into a feature-list.
